youtube.title: 鉛筆芯和鑽石都是碳，為何鑽石怕一敲、鉛筆還能通電？｜原來如此事務所
youtube.description:
畫完一整張圖手一擦就糊掉，手上這層黑黑的鉛筆芯，跟世界上最硬的鑽石竟然都是「碳」組成的！成分一模一樣，為什麼軟硬天差地遠？
用「同一盒積木的兩種搭法」一次看懂石墨與黏土比例、平面蜂巢網與 2 倍多層間距、鑽石立體四鍵攀爬架、1.5 倍密度差、硬度 1–10 與抗刮不等於耐敲的劈開方向，以及鉛筆線讓小燈發亮的自由電子秘密與罕見藍鑽例外！

📚 參考研究與官方出處：
- USGS PP1802-J (Graphite, 2017)：https://pubs.usgs.gov/pp/1802/j/pp1692j.pdf
- USGS Gemstones (Diamond hardness & specific gravity)：https://pubs.usgs.gov/gip/gemstones/mineral.html
- Chemistry LibreTexts (Network Covalent Atomic Solids: Carbon)：https://chem.libretexts.org/Bookshelves/General_Chemistry/Map%3A_Structure_and_Properties_(Tro)/13%3A_Phase_Diagrams_and_Crystalline_Solids/13.07%3A_Network_Covalent_Atomic_Solids-_Carbon_and_Silicates
- GIA (Diamond Care, Toughness & Cleavage / Diamond Types)：https://www.gia.edu/diamond-care-cleaning?lang=en
- Science Museum Group Learning (Graphite circuits)：https://www.sciencemuseumgroup.org.uk/learning/resources/graphite-circuits

data.prompt: Medium shot in the bright wooden office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, squinting skeptically while peering closely at the sharp grey tip of a yellow wooden pencil held in her five-fingered hand.

lines.text: 又能畫又能點燈也太扯了吧！先別管點燈，筆芯滑滑軟軟一擦就掉粉，難道不是摻了別的材料？

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit wooden workshop bench: two small ceramic bowls side by side—left filled with silky metallic-sheen dark-grey graphite powder, right filled with smooth pale earthy clay powder beside a raw grey pencil core.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 筆芯確實把黑亮微滑的石墨跟細黏土混在一起——但黏土只用來黏成形撐強度，讓你手上變黑的主角正是純碳做的石墨。

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 而鑽石幾乎也全是碳——把石墨跟鑽石裡的碳一顆顆拿出來比，成分根本完全一模一樣！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, squeezing both five-fingered fists together eagerly like compressing an invisible snowball.

lines.text: 成分一模一樣？那我猜，鑽石裡的碳一定是被硬擠得特別緊，才比鉛筆芯硬這麼多的吧！

data.prompt: Close-up warm studio macro on honey oak: a single handcrafted smooth wooden sphere resting at center with four evenly spaced short wooden pegs radiating outward like four outstretched arms.

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit studio table: smooth wooden spheres connected by short wooden pegs strictly to three neighbors each, forming a crisp flat hexagonal honeycomb mesh lying flat on the surface.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 石墨的搭法是每顆球只插三根木棍牽住旁邊三顆，全部平平攤在同一面上，搭成一張很牢的平面網。

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 接著把好多張平網一層一層疊起來——層跟層之間一根木棍都沒有，只靠很弱的力氣輕輕吸住。

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 而且層距大約是網內兩顆碳距離的兩倍多——所以紙面一磨，外層就整片滑下來，網裡的木棍一根都沒斷！

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 科學上的「硬」就是比誰抗刮：石墨軟到指甲就刮得動，開頭拿滿分十的鑽石，則是只有鑽石才刮得動鑽石！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, leaning forward with wide puzzled eyes holding both five-fingered palms up.

lines.text: 哇，只有鑽石才刮得動鑽石耶！那你一開頭怎麼說它怕鐵鎚重重一敲，這不就自相矛盾嗎？

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 不矛盾，因為「抗刮」跟「耐不耐敲」是兩回事！就像家裡玻璃杯指甲刮不出痕跡，掉地上卻會摔碎。

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 鑽石的立體攀爬架裡，也有幾個特定切面跨過去牽著的手比較少——順著這些切面重重一敲，照樣會裂開或崩角！

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 沒錯！切鑽石的師傅有時正是專門找準這幾個切面，順勢精準一敲，就把整顆原石俐落劈開！

scenes.chapter: 鉛筆線竟然能點亮電燈，鑽石反而不行？

lines.text: 哇，電線一碰上鉛筆黑線竟然真的亮了！筆芯又不是銅也不是鐵，這就是前面留下的第四隻空手在幫忙嗎？

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 猜得太準！電流是許多帶電小東西往前跑，叫「電子」；石墨每顆碳空出的第四隻手，讓一個電子能沿整張平面網自由奔跑！

data.prompt: Close-up warm studio macro: shimmering cyan-gold light particles streaming smoothly along the thick dark graphite line on cream paper right into the glowing tiny glass bulb.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 剛剛用力塗出的那條粗黑鉛筆線，瞬間成了電子的專用車道，一路衝過小燈，燈就亮起來了！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, holding up a sparkling toy diamond prism toward the tiny light bulb with bright hopeful curiosity.

lines.text: 太神奇了！那換成沒摻黏土、碳又擠得更密的鑽石接這顆九伏特乾電池，它沒空手，是不是就完全不會亮？

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 完全猜中！導電靠的不是碳多密，而是空出的第四隻手；鑽石四隻手全鎖死、電子動彈不得，一般的鑽石完全不會亮！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, narrowing her eyes like a sharp little detective noticing Chief's careful phrasing.

lines.text: 等等，你剛剛特別強調「一般的鑽石」完全不會亮——難道這世上還真有會導電的鑽石？

data.prompt: Close-up velvet-lined sunlit display dish: a rare breathtaking deep-sky-blue faceted diamond glowing with a faint delicate cyan electric shimmer, contrasted against plain clear colorless diamonds beside it.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 耳朵真尖！確實有個極少見的例外：一種非常罕見的藍色鑽石，因為裡頭混進了一點別的元素，反而會導一點電。

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the bright office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, tilting her head curiously and gesturing vertically up and down across the stacked honeycomb wooden model.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 連鑽石都有藍鑽例外！那回到會導電的石墨——層跟層空隙那麼大，電如果想穿過一層層跳過去，會不會超難走？

data.prompt: Close-up glowing studio diagram on dark slate: bright rushing golden streams flowing smoothly sideways along flat stacked honeycomb layers, contrasted with a single tiny hesitant spark struggling to hop vertically across the wide dark gap.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 你猜得超準！科學家實際量過，電在石墨裡沿著平面網走，比穿過層與層跳過去，好走幾百到上千倍！

data.prompt: Close-up side-by-side sketchbook tabletop experiment: a short thick black pencil line lighting a tiny glass bulb brightly warm gold on left; a very long winding black pencil line glowing a much dimmer pale amber bulb on right.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 而且石墨畢竟只是「還不錯」的導體，遠不如金屬銅線順暢——所以鉛筆線畫得越長，阻力越大，小燈就會越暗。

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, nodding brightly with an aha grin while holding up her yellow pencil beside the sketchbook.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 難怪剛才線要畫得又短又粗！那如果我在線中間不小心留了一道細細的斷口，小燈會變暗還是直接熄掉？

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 會直接熄掉！紙本身幾乎不導電，只要線斷開一絲縫隙，電子整條路就被截斷，想讓燈亮必須一筆用力連到底。

lines.text: 連一絲縫隙都不能留！對了，鉛筆盒裡軟黑鉛筆跟硬淡鉛筆畫一樣長不斷掉的線，哪一支會讓燈更亮？

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 所以我猜軟又黑的那支讓燈比較亮，因為裡頭石墨比例高——不過這只是我的猜測，科學上要真的量過才算數！

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 哈哈，連猜哪支更亮都要等量過才算數！對了，剛剛我們一直用木球和小木棍推演，真的碳原子長得就像木球嗎？

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, gently resting one five-fingered hand beside both small wooden ball-and-stick models with an appreciative smile.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 問得太好了！真的碳不是木球、牽手也不是木棍——模型只是幫我們看清「誰跟誰連著、連得多牢」的工具。

data.prompt: Close-up sunlit studio bench: the two handcrafted wooden models standing cleanly beside a brass balance scale, a small iron jeweler hammer, and a glowing miniature pencil-line bulb circuit, zero text.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 科學家最在意的，不是模型像不像玩具，而是它推算出的輕重、刮痕、裂面跟導電，全都能跟真實實驗對得上！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit wooden office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, nodding with sparkling eyes as she glances across the wooden models and desk props.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 原來模型不是要長得像實物，而是要幫大腦把藏在裡頭的規律一眼看透！難怪同一盒球和木棍這麼好用！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, smiling thoughtfully while gesturing gently toward the flat wooden mesh and the 3D climbing frame resting side by side.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 下次要是有人問你「碳硬不硬、會不會導電」，你得先反問他一句：你說的是哪一種排法的碳？

scenes.chapter: 原來不只要看成分，更要看怎麼排

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunny golden-hour study with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, beaming with a huge joyful lightbulb smile holding up her yellow pencil triumphantly.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 原來如此！還記得開頭我不敢相信鉛筆跟鑽石同種材料嗎？原來只看成分遠遠不夠，它們怎麼排隊牽手才決定一切！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the warm golden-hour wooden office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, smiling proudly behind her oak counter holding both wooden models gently.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 說得太棒了，而且是你一步步自己推通的！我覺得這正是材料世界最神奇的地方——同一盒零件換個搭法，個性整個翻轉。

data.prompt: Medium shot in the sunlit study with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi 8-year-old girl with generous headroom, glossy black bob with straight bangs and top cowlick, wide bright dark-brown aligned eyes, rosy cheeks, ink-navy toggle raincoat with bright mustard hood, five clean fingers, glancing back down at her sketchbook with two wooden pencils in hand and a playful curious grin.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 那現在回到開頭把我畫弄糊的鉛筆盒，有沒有什麼不用電池、在書桌上就能馬上試的小觀察？

data.prompt: Close-up cozy golden-hour sketchbook page: two neat pencil-shaded squares side by side—a velvety dark square showing a long smooth fingertip smudge trail vs a pale hard square staying crisp and clean.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 有啊！找兩支一黑一淡的鉛筆各塗一小塊，再用手指輕擦過去，親自比比看哪一塊滑得最遠、也最帶淡淡金屬亮光！

data.prompt: Medium shot inside the sunlit wooden office with generous headroom, 2.5-head chibi Taiwanese office chief woman with generous headroom, dark brown-black low side ponytail with silver-grey streak, round black glasses, warm brown aligned eyes, bare clean ears, mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over white shirt, dark navy trousers, five clean fingers, facing the viewer with a warm welcoming smile and one open five-fingered hand, clean wooden wall behind.

lines.speaker: chief
lines.text: 最後問問你：你家鉛筆盒裡哪一支最容易把手弄黑？你有玩過鉛筆線點亮小燈嗎？留言告訴我們！

lines.speaker: kid
lines.text: 喜歡從身邊不起眼的小東西挖出科學真相，別忘了訂閱原來如此事務所，我們下次見！
